summary: Lattice: data class wrapping the AccumulatorEngine build-phase output — a DataFrame of outermost rule combinations plus provenance metadata.

key_classes.name: Lattice
key_classes.summary: Stores combinations DataFrame, DimensionsMetadata, aggregates list, and optional partition_key. Exposes combinations, count, partition_key, metadata, aggregates properties.

lifecycle_notes: Lattice is built once per partition and cached by the caller — it does not recompute on access.
documentation_hooks: The Lattice is the primary artifact of the build phase; document it as a cacheable, serialization target.
partition_key is None for un-partitioned lattices (no CONTEXT_KEY dims).
open_questions: Lattice serialization (save/load) is not yet implemented — advanced users who want to cache lattices to disk must handle this themselves.
